rev.t:
Visited here frequently to check out the collection and offers running by Regal.
Obviously it never disappointed in any term, and also their all staff are …
I had recently visited their HSR showroom and had a very pleasant experience. Srikanth, Ajeesh and Eby were really helpful.

The store was very well maintained, and the collections were beautiful. The staff member Usha provided excellent customer service and guided us very well. We were fully satisfied with the experience. The service was on time with no waiting period, and everything was well organized and disciplined. Thank you to the entire team!
